post.topic: Automating real-time order status and feedback for restaurant takeaway and delivery
post.headline: Stop *losing customers* to missed delivery status updates
post.subline: Keep hungry customers informed with instant, automated WhatsApp notifications the moment their order leaves your kitchen.
post.caption:
Is your team wasting hours manually texting customers about their order status? Every minute spent typing 'your food is on the way' is a minute taken away from kitchen productivity. When customers don't know the status of their meal, they call your store, creating a bottleneck that slows down your operations.

Our AI integration triggers an automated WhatsApp message the second your POS marks an order as 'out for delivery.' It shares the driver's arrival window and a direct link to a feedback form. 

Quick tip: Use a standard order template that includes a one-click 'Report Issue' button to resolve delivery complaints before they turn into negative public reviews. 

Save this post and send it to a fellow restaurant owner. DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15-min call.
post.insight_note: Restaurants face high operational pressure, and automating repetitive status updates directly improves customer satisfaction while freeing up staff for service.
